name: studio
description: Root Producer orchestrator with optional execution commands and role-specific model/effort policy.

interface.shortDescription: Route missions and manage role-based native subagents.
interface.longDescription: Studio keeps the main Producer on the control plane, resolves optional work, review, and delivery commands plus provider- and role-specific model/effort policy, and dispatches native leaf crews without shipping another runtime or copying command state.
defaultPrompt: Use $execute in the root Producer session to route and run missions through configured optional commands.
Use $producer to cast the smallest useful crew and keep orchestration out of leaf agents.
Resolve .studio.yml model/effort before every fresh spawn and reuse original handles for rework.
